task.question: What type of incident is investigated by Counter Terrorism Policing in May 2026?

answer:
In May 2026, Counter Terrorism Policing in the United Kingdom investigated an incident involving the arrest of a man and a woman on suspicion of conspiracy to commit arson following an attack at the former East London Central Synagogue. This incident was part of a broader investigation into several apparent attacks on Jewish sites in London since late March. 

FINAL: Arson attack on synagogue

Police say the incident is being investigated alongside several apparent attacks on Jewish sites in London since late March.
